verdict.rationale: Missive is an email client, so inserting availability or bookable meeting times into an email is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents a scheduling-link or availability-sharing feature in the composer. The only calendar mention is that external AI apps can act on the calendar through MCP, and canned responses insert static templates; both are adjacent features or building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
